lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular pixel clusters are arranged in four primary vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. These clusters exhibit a regular spatial distribution, forming a rectilinear grid across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with horizontal rows of blobs, creating high-contrast anchor nodes. This grid-like intersection is most prominent in the region dorsal to the pectoral fin attachment point.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal linear feature is visible running along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance transition where the dorsal surface is bright and the ventral edge of the ridge is in shadow.

other_distinctive_markers: The cranial region displays a high-density labyrinthine or vermiculated pattern of irregular, high-luminance markings that transition into the larger, more symmetrical blobs of the lateral flank.
